1.desc: Compile-time constant numeric expression: named constant fast-path or a full folded expression (literals, Consts, predefined symbols, arithmetic); a quoted numeric string is also accepted; rejects a live variable.

2.desc: General runtime expression or value; may be a variable, literal, or arithmetic expression; no compile-time type check.

3.desc: FOR loop header: Var = start TO end [STEP step], parsed as one unit (4 words: variable, start, end, step).

4.desc: Constant integer/keyword, tolerant of being absent at end of line (e.g. Do/Loop/Else's optional While/Until marker); when absent, all remaining codes for the instruction are silently defaulted.

5.desc: Compile-time constant only; always rejects a variable reference (paired with 38, the time-unit-scaled variant).

6.desc: A name token whose meaning is instruction-specific (Sub name, table name, or a Var=UnitString pair for Units); captured as raw text and interpreted/validated later, not compiled here.

7.desc: General expression used as a condition (If/While/Select/Case); no compile-time type restriction.

8.desc: Destination variable or array (no index required); accepts a promotable expression but rejects a bare literal.

9.desc: Dim variable declaration: Name[(dims)] [As Type] [= init | {init,...}].

10.desc: Public variable declaration; identical parser to code 9.

11.desc: Raw expression text captured verbatim for later compilation (DataTable statistics function Source parameters); no type/constancy check at this layer.

12.desc: Sub parameter-list declaration; enforces OPTIONAL/required ordering and initializer rules.

13.desc: Comma-separated list of general expressions up to a closing ')' (Call's argument list).

15.desc: Not emitted by any CR6 instruction; real switch case exists in the decompiled parser but is unreachable from instructions.json.

16.desc: End/Exit's optional target keyword (Prog/Sub/Function/...); absent is valid.

17.desc: NEXT's optional trailing keyword (Scan or SubScan); an unrecognised token is silently treated as absent.

18.desc: Rest-of-line text captured verbatim (MenuPick's menu label).

19.desc: Constant integer/keyword (e.g. bridge RevEx flag); failure to resolve is silently ignored rather than reported.

20.desc: Data-type/range/units keyword, constant-only, validated against a per-instruction allowed set.

21.desc: Not emitted by any CR6 instruction.

22.desc: Not emitted by any CR6 instruction.

23.desc: Not emitted by any CR6 instruction (shares a no-op goto with used code 32).

24.desc: General expression/value (shares a handler with 40, without 40's extra output-marking flag).

25.desc: General runtime expression/value; second most common code; a non-constant argument here is one of the documented triggers for forcing Sequential mode (docs/modes.md).

26.desc: General expression/reference, flagged variant of 25, used where the token may need to resolve against a different namespace (e.g. table/module name).

27.desc: Variable/array reference, array-checked like 8/29; oracle testing showed it rejects a table name and accepts a plain variable.

28.desc: General expression/value (shares a handler with 2/27); accepts a variable syntactically even where the consuming instruction then imposes its own stricter constant-only rule.

29.desc: Destination variable/array, array-checked; stricter sibling of code 8.

30.desc: Two words per argument: an internal word followed by the value (VoiceSpeak only); purpose of the extra word not fully determined.

31.desc: Not emitted by any CR6 instruction; real switch case exists (constant-only expression with a 'Parameter %s must be a constant.' check) but unreachable from instructions.json.

32.desc: No-op marker: consumes no argument text (RainFlowSample's first parameter).

33.desc: Variable/array reference, array-checked, with an extra 2-word allowance when a string/array-length flag is set.

34.desc: Return's expression; accepted shape depends on the enclosing Function's declared return type.

35.desc: Function parameter-list declaration; identical parser to code 12.

37.desc: ConstTable's optional table-name argument; presence is checked but the text itself is not stored (0 words) - only ever used as its optional form, 137.

38.desc: Paired, unit-scaled sibling of code 5 (rounds by a stored time-unit divisor after parsing).

39.desc: Paired sibling of code 1 with an extra rounding step against a stored time-unit divisor (e.g. Scan's Units parameter).

40.desc: General expression/value (shares a handler with 24); additionally sets an internal output/disable-reference flag.

41.desc: Variable/array reference (Move's Dest); shares flags with 27/28's handler family.

42.desc: Variant of the general expression handler with extra auto-temp-variable machinery specific to VibratingWire.

43.desc: Not emitted by any CR6 instruction.

44.desc: Not emitted by any CR6 instruction.

45.desc: StructureType/ObjectType name declaration; registers a new named type context, rejects nesting.

48.desc: Variable/array reference, array-checked (flags 0x4000); only ever used as its optional form, 148.

101.desc: Optional Mask/Interval-style constant (e.g. WriteIO's, ExciteV's trailing constant); still rejects a variable once present.

105.desc: Optional constant-only value (e.g. Thermistor/VibratingWire trailing settling/multiplier constants).

108.desc: Optional constant/keyword (e.g. SlowSequence's, Calibrate's trailing option).

125.desc: Optional general expression (AvgRun/TotalRun/StdDevRun's RunReset/TotalCalls/Call_ID parameters); confirmed to accept a variable, a literal, or omission.

137.desc: Optional identifier (ConstTable's table name); presence-only, no text stored.
